ctx.x: That's bad. You'll be writing the same things, the same arrangements -- and different arrangements, I mean. And that's really bad, so I used to go the Savoy down to the Hotel Clinton, many and had everything, and hear these bands, you know. I even went to hear Guy Lombardo one time. I found something there. I used it.
Well that band was always a good musicianship band, whatever style they were playing.
